# Why ggplot2?

- Grammar of Graphics
- Consistent layering
- Works great with tidy data

---

# Template

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = var_x, y = var_y, color = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "", subtitle = "", caption = "")
```

---

# Tips

- Use `theme_minimal()` for clarity
- Always label axes
- Use `scale_color_brewer()` when categories > 3
